_doc: WORLD 1 QUEST DATA. Loaded by Quests/QuestDatabase.LoadAll (mirrors monsters.json).
objective kind values: KillMob, CollectItem, ReachLocation, TalkToNpc, UseAbility, CatchFish, EatFood, CookFood.
TargetId: mob/item/npc/ability id; empty means any of that kind. Count defaults 1.
Location + Radius apply to ReachLocation only. GiverNpcId empty = auto-accepting chain quest.
PrereqQuestId must be turned in first. StartCutscene/CompleteCutscene name StreamingAssets/cutscenes/<id>.json.
Edit freely, no rebuild needed at runtime; the editor picks it up on the next play.

quests.Name: A Word from Aldric
quests.Description: Aldric, the old warden of the clearing, wants to speak with you.

Objectives.LocationHint: Aldric waits in the forest glade where you woke, north of the city

quests.Name: Find Your Footing
quests.Description: Aldric bids you test your arm. Use one of your abilities in the field.

Objectives.LocationHint: Right here in the glade, press keys 1-5

quests.Name: A Fisher's Patience
quests.Description: Take the pole to Emberfall Lake and land your first catch.

Objectives.Description: Catch a fish at Emberfall Lake
Objectives.LocationHint: The lake lies northwest of the city, fish from its east bank, or swim right in

quests.Name: Cook, Then Eat
quests.Description: Cook your catch at the campfire and eat it to mend your wounds. Store-bought meals teach you nothing.

Objectives.LocationHint: Use the lakeside campfire with a raw fish in your bag
Eat from your bag once your fish is cooked

quests.Name: A Mother's Plea
quests.Description: Grukmar the Warlord has stolen a girl away to his forest warcamp. Cut him down, free her, and bring word back to her mother in town.

Objectives.LocationHint: Grukmar's warcamp lies in the southwest woods, beyond the city

Objectives.Description: Return to the girl's mother in town
Objectives.LocationHint: Her mother waits near the fountain in the city square

quests.Name: Clear the Forest Roads
quests.Description: With the girl home safe, the town asks more: goblins prowl the western woods and bandits the east. Thin them out so the roads breathe again.

Objectives.LocationHint: The goblin camp squats in the western woods
The bandit camp hides in the eastern woods

quests.Name: Smoke on the Horizon
quests.Description: Ash drifts thicker every day, and the southern sky glows after dark. Walk the Ember Approach and see with your own eyes what the mountain is becoming.

Objectives.LocationHint: Follow the charred road south of the city until the ember-rain thickens

quests.Name: The Heart of the Mountain
quests.Description: The volcano is waking, and Emberfall stands in the path of its fire. Descend into the caldera, fight through its halls, and slay the beast at its heart before the city burns.

Objectives.Description: Slay the beast of the caldera
Objectives.LocationHint: The volcano's mouth opens at the far south end of the Ember Approach
